timing: Written after inspecting only operational aggregate metrics (640/640 success, gate pass, row counts, global free-SD/extreme ranges) and before inspecting condition-level recovery, paired contrasts, or threshold results.
purpose: Freeze exact descriptive screening summaries already required by the parent plan.

analysis_sets.thresholds: All six data-generating criterion-specific PCM thresholds per run.
analysis_sets.eligibility: Use only IncludedInStudy rows, while separately retaining all attempted-run denominators and failure taxonomy.

run_level_metrics.cmle_extremes: PersonsExtreme and PersonsInformative from the prefit/fit audit; denominator is informative plus extreme Persons.

paired_contrasts.shape: For each estimator, design, facet/threshold metric, and replicate: non-normal minus normal.
paired_contrasts.design: For each estimator, distribution, facet/threshold metric, and replicate: planned-connected minus complete.
paired_contrasts.free_sd_shape: For each design and replicate: non-normal minus normal estimated SD.
paired_contrasts.free_sd_design: For each distribution and replicate: planned-connected minus complete estimated SD.

summary_contract: For every paired contrast report N, mean, sample SD, Monte Carlo SE=SD/sqrt(N), and mean +/- 1.96*SE labelled screening normal-approximation interval. Report no p-values or multiplicity-selected winners.
interpretation_rules: Intervals excluding zero are screening signals for a possible systematic condition contrast, not confirmatory significance.
Agreement of signs across estimands may prioritize a future contrast but does not make likelihood bases interchangeable.
Lower RMSE in this finite screening is not an estimator recommendation.
Extreme-Person loss is part of the CMLE result and is never silently excluded from the condition denominator.
No 100-replicate extension is authorized until selected contrasts and target precision are fixed prospectively.
